//: A deterministic review workflow (M101). Run: jichi workflow examples/workflow.review.json
//items: Replace the map items with the files you want reviewed.
name: review

stages.prompt: Read $ITEM and review it for correctness bugs, resource leaks, and unclear code. Cite file:line. Be terse; if it looks fine, say so in one line.
Combine the per-file reviews into one prioritized report: 'must fix' first, then 'nice to have'. Drop duplicates and anything that says the file is fine.
